title: Hungarians Who Built Classic Hollywood
grammar: Simultaneity and contrastive background action with miközben ('while / at the same time')
goal: I can describe, using miközben, how Hungarian-born producers and directors helped to shape early Hollywood.
I can connect concurrent events and contrast concurrent states using the conjunction miközben.
I can discuss silent cinema, studio production, and film directing in B2 Hungarian.

sections.title: Allegory on Screen: A Century of Hungarian Cinema
body: From the earliest silent experiments in Kolozsvár and Budapest to the soundstages of Hollywood, Hungarian filmmakers have exerted an outsized influence on world cinema. Yet one of Hungarian cinema's best-known achievements was a visual poetry of allegory: finding cinematic metaphors for freedom, power, and historical trauma under censorship.

In this unit, you will journey from Hollywood's Hungarian studio pioneers (Adolph Zukor, William Fox, Michael Curtiz) to the choreographies of Miklós Jancsó, István Szabó's Oscar-winning Mephisto, the auteur vision of Márta Mészáros and Béla Tarr, and contemporary masterworks like Saul fia. Grammatically, you will revisit the subordinating conjunctions of simultaneity, immediate sequence, and repeated occurrence that you know from earlier units (miközben, mialatt, amint, mihelyt, valahányszor).
